newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Moslem rebels attack army camps in Philippines.
newsitem.headline: Moslem rebels attack army camps in Philippines.

text.p: Fighting resumed between Moslem rebels and the military in the southern Philippines early on Saturday, just hours after they signed a ceasefire pact, an army officer said.
No casualties were reported in the gunbattle which lasted for an hour.

Army Captain Salih Indanan told reporters the fighting erupted after 150 heavily armed members of the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF) bombarded two army camps in Buldon, Maguindanao near Zamboanga with at least 19 rounds of 81-mm mortars.
Soldiers fired three rounds of 105-mm Howitzer cannon to repulse the MILF attack, he said.
On Friday, Defence Secretary Renato de Villa announced that the Philippine government and the MILF signed an agreement to enforce a ceasefire and resume their peace negotiations.
The MILF, which has been fighting for an Islamic state in southern Mindanao island, called off the peace talks last June 28 following a series of gunbattles which claimed more than 150 lives.
